verdict.rationale: Honeybadger documents official client libraries that automatically report errors once installed and configured, including a Ruby gem with a CLI reference, JS packages with instrumentation options, and a Python Oban integration. Community users also report the Capistrano deploy integration working well. missing for 10: a documented catalog of supported language SDKs, evidence of SDK coverage for the management/read APIs (not just error reporting), and in-depth independent hands-on corroboration of building against the SDKs.
